messages:
Maya Chen: Kicking off the quarterly stability digest — want to capture recurring incidents that keep resurfacing and lock owners + realistic timelines. Correlate with postmortem action items (especially infra + deploy-related ones).

Sahil Patel: Thanks — I ran the recurrence query this morning. Top 3 recurring signatures: high KV cache miss during warm ups, scheduler thrash on burst, and multi-model quantization fallback.

Jamal Rivera: can you paste the query results? want counts and last-seen dates.

Sahil Patel: pasted below:
```
- KV cache miss (pattern id: KVM-7): 48 incidents, last seen 2026-02-14
- Scheduler thrash (pattern id: STH-3): 32 incidents, last seen 2026-03-01
- Quant fallback (pattern id: QFB-2): 18 incidents, last seen 2026-03-08
```

Trisha Gupta: From postmortems, KVM-7 often links to cold-start traffic and bad autoscale cooldown settings. We recommended a config change (autoscale cooldown = 60s) in 4 separate PMs but adoption is partial.

Lina Ortiz: We should map each recurring pattern to the outstanding action items and mark them P0/P1 based on user impact.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Suggest a short triage table and owners — next steps in this thread. I propose we run a 3-week remediation sprint for KVM-7 and STH-3, and a follow-on exploratory for QFB-2 (needs infra + model-team coordination).

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly incident digest posted in #incidents every Monday.

Sahil Patel: Drafting action list now. Posting tentative owner + ETA. Feedback welcome.

Sahil Patel:
```
Action items (tentative):
1) KVM-7: Roll out autoscale cooldown = 60s + prefix-level KV caching (owner: Trisha) — ETA: 2026-03-28
2) STH-3: Scheduler backoff tuning + add health-checks to burst lanes (owner: Jamal) — ETA: 2026-03-21
3) QFB-2: Quantization regression triage + small-scale experiments (owner: Lina + model-team) — ETA: 2026-04-08
4) Measurement: Add recurrence flag to incident metadata + daily digest filter (owner: Maya) — ETA: 2026-03-18
```

Trisha Gupta: I can take KVM-7. Quick note: need a rollout window and smoke test. Can we reserve capacity on Thu 03/25?

Jamal Rivera: I'll start STH-3 changes tomorrow. ETA looks tight but doable. Will post a short runbook for verifying backoff.

Lina Ortiz: I'll sync with ModelOps on QFB-2 — want to ensure we don't regress model quality with any quant change. Suggest a canary on low-traffic project.

Maya Chen: Nice. Two process asks: 1) put each action into the postmortem tracker (link: https://go.redwood/postmortems) and tag with the pattern id; 2) let's add a weekly check-in for owners (15m) until complete.

Sahil Patel: Done: added items to tracker and tagged KVM-7/STH-3/QFB-2.

Trisha Gupta: booked canary window Thu 03/25 01:00-03:00 UTC and created smoke test checklist in the runbook.

Jamal Rivera: runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/scheduler-backoff. I'll add verification steps and a rollback plan.

Maya Chen: Great. Lina, can you confirm ModelOps availability for QFB-2 by EOD Wed?

Lina Ortiz: Confirmed — ModelOps ok to help.

Maya Chen: Final ask — for the monthly recurring-theme review, let's produce a one-page summary with: top 3 patterns, active owners, progress status, and next blockers. I'll draft the template and send to this thread. :eyes:

ops-bot: Incident recurrence tags updated for 3 items.

Sahil Patel: Template received from Maya — filling progress column now.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — will follow up with the 15m check-ins calendar invite. If any owner needs to push ETA, reply here with new ETA and reason. :thumbsup:
